basis: The pie chart explicitly labels each segment with its percentage share of global energy consumption: Nuclear (45%), Hydroelectric (30%), Fossil Fuels (15%), and Renewables (10%). Nuclear is the largest category at 45%. The routing criterion requires escalating the largest category to priority source monitoring. The 'Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring' option directly corresponds to this requirement.
option_label: Escalate Nuclear for priority source monitoring
